Shearbolt test vulnerability database
=====================================

This archive is a Grype vulnerability database (SQLite) that only Shearbolt's own tests use. It is a
frozen test fixture: do not use it to judge real software, whose known vulnerabilities change daily.

How it was made: .github/workflows/test-db.yml in https://github.com/klar-web-services/shearbolt ran
grype-db (Anchore, Apache-2.0) on Anchore's processed vunnel data for the four sources below.
grype-db converts the records into Grype's database format. That changes their structure and
derives some fields, for example fix versions from NVD configurations. No record was edited by hand.

Sources and terms
-----------------

The database contains data from these four sources only.

1. GitHub Advisory Database, by GitHub, Inc. and its contributors
   https://github.com/advisories (https://github.com/github/advisory-database)
   License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0),
   https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
   Modified as described above.

2. National Vulnerability Database (NVD), NIST
   https://nvd.nist.gov/
   This product uses data from the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD.
   CVE records in it are covered by the CVE Terms of Use below.

3. Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog, CISA
   https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog
   License: CC0 1.0 Universal. Its use does not imply endorsement by CISA or DHS.

4. Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS), FIRST
   https://www.first.org/epss/
   Published freely by FIRST, which asks for attribution: EPSS, FIRST.org.
